items.name: getDatabaseCreationScript
items.description: Gets the database creation script from the resource annotation if it exists. If not, creates the default database creation script.
items.remarks:
The default script is
```
.create database DATABASE_NAME persist (PERSISTENCE_PATH/DATABASE_NAME/md, PERSISTENCE_PATH/DATABASE_NAME/data) ifnotexists
```
where
DATABASE_NAME is the database name and PERSISTENCE_PATH is .
